questions.solution:

25 percent of marked price is equal to 40 percent of cost price .

Concept used:

SP = CP + Profit

Profit = CP × (Profit percentage / 100)

Profit is calculated on cost price and discount is calculated on market price

40 percent of cost price is 200 / 4 = 50

The cost price is 50 × 5 /2 = 125

Profit percentage,

200- 125over125 × 100

⇒ (75 /125) × 100 = 60%

**∴ The correct option is 3**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 1500 amounts to Rs. 2175 in 3 years at simple interest. If rate of interest is increased by 3 percent, then what will be the new amount?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Extra interest generated by the 3% rate increase over 3 years = (P × Extra Rate × T) ÷ 100

⇒ Extra SI = (1500 × 3 × 3) ÷ 100 = Rs. 135

New Amount = Initial Amount + Extra SI

⇒ New Amount = 2175 + 135 = 2310

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 2310.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 1500

Amount in 3 years (A) = Rs. 2175

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount = Principal + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c659e1767799b38ff4968967fc52c5da8296c39a13182a83a5d33da3159b767.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ SI = A − P

⇒ SI = 2175 − 1500 = Rs. 675

⇒ 675 = (1500 × R × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ 675 = 45 × R

⇒ R = 675 ÷ 45 = 15%

Now, the new rate of interest = 15% + 3% = 18%

⇒ New SI = (1500 × 18 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ New SI = 45 × 18 = Rs. 810

⇒ New Amount = P + New SI

⇒ New Amount = 1500 + 810 = Rs. 2310

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 2310.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest

When interest is compounded annually, the amount is calculated as: Amount = P × (1 + R ÷ 100)T.

SI vs CI Difference

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 2 years on the same principal is calculated as: Difference = P × (R ÷ 100)².

Rule of 72

A quick mental math shortcut to estimate the number of years required to double your money at a given annual interest rate. Time to double ≈ 72 ÷ Rate of Interest.

questions.question: A person covers first 26 km in 60 minutes and next 34 km in 30 minutes. What is his average speed for the whole journey?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A person covers first 26 km in 60 minutes and the next 34 km in 30 minutes.

**Concept used:**

Average speed = Total distance traveled / Total time taken

**Calculation:**

Total time taken is 60 + 30 = 90 minutes

Total distance travelled is 26 + 34 = 60 km

90 minutes = 1.5 hr

The average speed is 60 / 1.5 = 40km /hr

**∴ The correct option is 1**
